title: Oswald infiltrates Free Cuba group and is arrested in New Orleans
summary: Dan Sheehan tells of Oswald infiltrates Free Cuba group and is arrested in New Orleans, about 1963 at New Orleans, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: He he infiltrated the group. That was when he got arrested on the street, remember?

plain: A lawyer and researcher named Dan Sheehan, talking with a podcast host, Jesse Michels, tells a story about Lee Harvey Oswald, the man accused of shooting President John F. Kennedy in 1963. Sheehan says that in New Orleans that year Oswald worked his way into a group campaigning for a Cuba free of its communist government, and that this was when he was arrested on the street. Sheehan tells it as part of his case that Oswald was working undercover for someone rather than acting alone.
